The '''Wandering Trader''' is a passive trading mob. In Matcha Flavoured it can be called to the player's base with a [[Beacon Kindling]], and it has new trades: it sells [[Asylum Seeker]] applications and village maps, and buys music discs. The developer wanted to make wandering traders "a bit more" useful: "They'll buy music discs, carry maps to nearby villages, but they also have a new item."<ref>{{Cite video|quote=I tried to make wandering traders a bit more They'll buy music discs, carry maps to nearby villages, but they also have a new item. Refugee applications.}}</ref>

== Spawning ==
=== Beacon Kindling ===
{{Main|Beacon Kindling}}
Placing a [[Beacon Kindling]] lights a signal fire and summons a wandering trader next to it:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/beacon_kindling/10s_loop.mcfunction}}</ref>
# When the kindling is placed, players within 128 blocks see "A Wandering Trader has spotted your beacon, they will arrive in 10 minutes".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/beacon_kindling/beacon_kindling_used.mcfunction}}</ref>
# The pack counts down every 10 seconds. After 10 minutes (60 steps) the trader appears 1 block beside the fire, and players within 128 blocks see "The Wandering Trader has arrived, they will depart in 5 minutes".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/beacon_kindling/place_beacon_kindling.mcfunction}}</ref>
# The trader has its own 5-minute countdown (30 steps). When it runs out, the trader leaves in a puff of smoke and players within 128 blocks see "The Wandering Trader has left". The fire goes out at the same time, 15 minutes (90 steps) after it was lit.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/beacon_kindling/summon_wandering_trader.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/beacon_kindling/kill_beacon.mcfunction}}</ref>
The countdowns run only while the fire or the trader is in a loaded chunk, so they pause while no player is near and survive reloading the data pack and leaving the world. The summoned trader is invulnerable.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/beacon_kindling/summon_wandering_trader.mcfunction}}</ref> When it leaves it is teleported 1,000 blocks down before being removed, so it drops nothing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/beacon_kindling/kill_wandering_trader.mcfunction}}</ref>

If the fire is put out or broken before the time is up, players within 128 blocks of it see "The Wandering Trader has lost sight of your beacon..." at the next check and the summon is cancelled; if the trader has already arrived, the summoned trader nearest to the fire leaves.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/beacon_kindling/kill_wandering_trader_early.mcfunction}}</ref>

Each player can light one beacon every 15 minutes, counted from placing it while the player is online; a cancelled beacon doesn't shorten the wait. Placing another kindling during that time shows that player "You have already summoned a Wandering Trader, please wait patiently while they travel"; the second fire stays lit but summons nothing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/beacon_kindling/beacon_kindling_used.mcfunction}}</ref> Different players can call traders at the same time.

=== Natural spawning ===
The pack does not change the vanilla game rules for wandering trader spawning, so wandering traders can also appear on their own as in vanilla ''Minecraft''. They use the same trades.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/setup/gamerules.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Trades ==
A wandering trader rolls three sets of trades when it spawns:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/trade_set/wandering_trader/buying.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/trade_set/wandering_trader/common.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/trade_set/wandering_trader/uncommon.json}}</ref>
* 4 Asylum Seeker applications;
* 6 of the 21 music disc trades;
* 3 of the 6 map trades.
Wandering trader trades give no villager XP.

=== Asylum Seekers ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Wants !! Gives !! Uses
|-
| {{ItemLink|Obol}} || {{ItemLink|Asylum Seeker}} || 1
|}
Each of the 4 offers is rolled separately, so every application has its own randomly chosen age, culture and cause of emigration.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/wandering_trader/asylum_seeker.json}}</ref> See [[Asylum Seeker]] for the odds.

=== Music discs ===
The trader buys vanilla music discs for obols. Each trade can be used 999 times.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/wandering_trader/music_disc_pigstep.json}}</ref>

The trades check only the disc's item type. The pack's own [[Music Disc|music discs]] are vanilla disc items underneath (most of them disc 11), so the trader buys them at the price of the vanilla disc they are built on.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/music_disc_golden.json}}</ref>

=== Maps ===
{{Main|Explorer maps}}
Each map costs 1 obol and can be bought once.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/wandering_trader/village_plains.json}}</ref>

A map trade is dropped if no such structure lies within 100 chunks.

== Advancements ==
* '''Bonfire Lit''': use a Beacon Kindling to signal a Wandering Trader. Rewards 1 obol.
* '''A Good Samaritan''': "Cover the Relocation costs for an Asylum Seeker, and make a home for them here" by buying an Asylum Seeker. Rewards 1 obol.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/trade_for_asylum_seeker.json}}</ref>
* <span class="mfw-spoiler">'''God help you...''' (hidden): kill a villager or a wandering trader.</span>

== Trivia ==
* The pack reuses the vanilla trade set names: the "buying" set holds the Asylum Seekers the trader sells, and the "common" set holds the discs it buys.
